note: Label G d with a Frame is V_d with the same radial condition, weights, bidegrees, invariance, bihomogeneous basis and conjugation. The coefficient space Frame.Coeff carries the sup norm, and the l1 coeffSize is only an auxiliary size used in estimates, so the mapper's norm difference does not hold.

def realBar {d : ℕ} : Label G d →ₛₗ[starRingEnd ℂ] Label G d where
  toFun v := ⟨conjPol v.val, conj_mem v⟩
  map_add' p q := Subtype.ext (map_add (MvPolynomial.map (starRingEnd ℂ)) p.val q.val)
  map_smul' c p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply eval_ext
    intro A
    change read A (conjPol (c • p.val)) = read A (star c • conjPol p.val)
    rw [conj_value,map_smul,map_smul, conj_value]
    simp
